statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The post-NVIDIA price path is retracement-rich rather than one-way, so Tail sits in the low band while Stress stays elevated on sticky inflation and unresolved Hormuz diplomacy.
recommendation: Conditions are described as orderly two-way price discovery. headline: NVIDIA beat lifts NQ, but the spike round-trips: Tail stays low, Stress elevated
body: NVIDIA reported Q2 fiscal 2027 revenue of $96.2 billion, up 106% year over year, with non-GAAP earnings of $2.22 per share, a 75.0% gross margin and third-quarter revenue guidance of $108.0 billion plus or minus 2%. The shares traded roughly 4% higher after hours near $218.77. Nasdaq-100 September futures opened the new session firmer, ran to 29,654.75, then gave back about two thirds of the advance to 29,467.50 (+0.61%) near the 29,432.50 session low as of 01:15Z. That completed round trip is the central observation: the largest single-name catalyst of the cycle produced a spike that mean-reverted rather than a persistent no-retracement extension. Cross-asset context is calm to mildly conflicting. VIX closed at 15.21, down 1.55% and at its session low. The 10-year Treasury yield is near 4.67% and the 2-year near 4.17% on the latest H.15 print, roughly flat on the day. WTI is about $81.94 and Brent about $87.66, both extending declines as Iran-Oman talks and reported U.S.-Iran ceasefire diplomacy raise the prospect of reopening the Strait of Hormuz, where transit volumes remain far below normal. Asian equities are firmer, with KOSPI up 1.8% and the Nikkei up 0.9%, while Nasdaq-100 futures hold only part of their pop, a divergence that argues for continued two-way trade. The stress backdrop remains real: July core PCE held at 3.3% year over year with headline at 3.7%, leaving the rate path unresolved, and the Nasdaq-100 cash index closed Wednesday down 0.17% at 29,995.38 having faded from 30,195.72. The forward path therefore keeps Tail in the low band through the Asian and European hours, lifts it to the WATCH band for the 13:00Z-15:00Z stretch that contains the U.S. cash open and the first full hour of cash NVIDIA repricing, then eases it back as post-open discovery normalises.

lookbackSummary: Over the preceding 24 hours Claude held Tail in the 10-16 band through the Wednesday European and U.S. sessions, with Stress drifting up from 47 to 61 as the market positioned into core PCE and the NVIDIA print. Tail stepped to 21 for the 20:00Z hour containing the earnings release, then decayed to 18 and 16 as the initial reaction proved two-sided. Two hourly slots, 21:00Z and 00:00Z, have no published Claude assessment and are marked unavailable.
outlookSummary: The forward window keeps Tail in the 11-17 band across the Asian and European hours on the assumption that the completed post-earnings round trip leaves mean reversion available. It rises to 20 and 21 for the 13:00Z and 14:00Z hours covering the U.S. cash open and the first full hour of cash NVIDIA repricing, the one stretch where opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks is a credible conditional risk, then decays through the afternoon to 11 by the end of the window. Stress follows a similar arc from 52 to a 62 peak and back to 44. Scheduled checkpoints inside the window are U.S. jobless claims at 12:30Z and the 13:30Z cash open; Michigan sentiment final and a Fed Chair Warsh speech follow on 28 August at 14:00Z.
